source_units.text: Write an original anecdote with a punchline.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: The anecdote concerns a very punctual snail arriving a year late because it followed the wrong calendar.
The punchline should claim it is still early for next year.
The text must contain "a very punctual snail", "the wrong calendar", "still early" verbatim.
This will be read by an audience at an invented storytelling club.
Keep the complete piece to 60–90 words.
The style should feel light and playful.
